purpose: SG-01 re-baseline BEFORE snapshot (proposal 07-12 R2). Recompute the same stats from .claude/logs/memory-recall.jsonl after ~1 week of live traffic on the R1 fix (timeout 3000->7000ms, reason codes, failed-daemon fallback -> --text-only) and compare. Fields daemon_fail_reason + uv_mode only exist in post-fix rows.
note: total_elapsed_ms is WHOLE-HOOK elapsed (probe + recall + merge), not daemon-call latency alone. Post-fix attribution should pivot on daemon_fail_reason.

success_criteria.uv_fallback_p50_ms: ~5000 or less when it does fall back (text-only cap) instead of ~12300
success_criteria.no_hit_rate_regression: kept_after_floor / results_count distribution comparable to baseline
